summary: PO 2023 section 7: 39 ECTS compulsory modules (Allgemeine Mechatronik 6, Höhere Informatik 6, Höhere Mathematik 4 6, Höhere Regelungstechnik 6, Projekt Mechatronische Systeme 6, key competencies 9), then one specialization (Kraftfahrzeugtechnik und nachhaltige Mobilität, Optomechatronische Systeme, or Smart Mechatronic Systems) of 51 ECTS (18 ECTS basic modules and 33 ECTS advanced modules), and the 30 ECTS thesis. Allgemeine Mechatronik has no module in this semester's data. eCampus files the PO specialization Optomechatronische Systeme as the area Schwerpunkt Optoelektronische Systeme (5 modules, 28 ECTS this semester); the other two areas offer more than 5. The handbook does not mark which offered modules are basic or advanced.
